description: Adds coverage for cloning configured data sources, verifying that core connection and pool settings are preserved while mutable collections remain independent between the original and clone.
Covers checkpoint scheduler behavior when the configured minimum pause exceeds the supported limit, including delay capping and rescheduling while processing backlog.
Verifies that rebuilding and replacing table metadata preserves essential identifiers and sequence information, retains metadata history, and correctly evaluates a supplied snapshot list.
Covers sync client generation for endpoint discovery overrides and verifies that EC2 service models use the EC2-specific protocol implementation.
Covers exporter resource lifecycle behavior by verifying state recreation after reset and initialization, as well as the narrowly scoped handling of missing-document errors for operation indices.

Verifies the UI model produced for anonymous login requests and authenticated stylesheet requests, including public URL handling, UI settings, user details, and filtering of CSS and JavaScript extensions.
Verifies programmatic servlet listener registration by class name and confirms that servlet-context attribute changes emit the expected listener notifications.
Confirms exact escaping and omission behavior for XML nodes and attributes, and property-map serialization for null, empty, escaped, and valueless entries.
Covers bean-key identity across qualifiers and generic type arguments, and verifies that runtime singleton registration refreshes cached lookups while supporting qualified collection access.
Covers linking an external boarding location to the nearest visible platform vertex and rejecting real-time linking before the graph has been indexed.
Verifies that copying a complex MATCH statement preserves its query clauses while independently copying mutable nested match expressions and return projections.
Confirms that creating an analysis applies the configured report renderer, relative source root, and existing language property bundle.
Verifies that Qute template roots are normalized and deduplicated, while template variants are grouped by base name and filtered using the configured suffixes.
Covers removing an image by correlation ID, including resource cleanup and image-list updates, and verifies that a subscription description accurately reports its connection state and metadata.
Confirms that the deprecated file-backed configuration API still delegates reads correctly and returns the supplied defaults when configuration values are absent.
Verifies conversion of nested package nodes into the correct Java package hierarchy and confirms that repeated package lookups reuse the same converted Java node.
